decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already adds power-button lighting to the simultaneous electrical loads and corresponding power-headroom requirement.
The source specifies visual reproduction requirements but does not necessarily require a new BOM deliverable or change any currently selected component.
The required lighting around the power button introduces an electrical connection that must be represented in the current wiring plan.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please reproduce the rendered colors and buttons, the logo along the bottom, the “Deck 1” and “Deck 2” labels, the lighting around the power button, and the back-panel design and font.

wiring_plan_components: solenoid valve and station-button control circuit
value_updates.wiring_plan_content: include the approved solenoid valve and its press-to-open, release-to-stop dispensing-button control, plus wiring for the required lighting around the power button
